contested.description: If the normalized label part of this index is less than 20 characters (all alphabet a-z, A-Z, 0, 1, and -) then a masternode vote contest takes place to give out the name

normalizedLabel.description: Domain label converted to lowercase for case-insensitive uniqueness validation. "o", "i" and "l" replaced with "0" and "1" to mitigate homograph attack. e.g. 'b0b'
normalizedLabel.$comment: Generated by the platform from the label when left out. A value sent must equal what it generates.

parentDomainName.description: A full parent domain name. e.g. 'dash'.

normalizedParentDomainName.description: A parent domain name in lowercase for case-insensitive uniqueness validation. "o", "i" and "l" replaced with "0" and "1" to mitigate homograph attack. e.g. 'dash'
normalizedParentDomainName.$comment: Generated by the platform from parentDomainName when left out. A value sent must equal what it generates. Must name an existing domain, or be empty for a top-level domain, which only the data contract owner can create.

preorderSalt.description: Salt used in the preorder document
preorderSalt.$comment: Reveals the writer's own preorder, made in an earlier block, whose saltedDomainHash is the double sha-256 of this salt, the normalized label, '.' and the parent domain name. The create deletes the preorder.

identity.description: Identifier name record that refers to an Identity

allowSubdomains.description: This option defines who can create subdomains: true - anyone; false - only the domain owner
allowSubdomains.$comment: Only the domain owner is allowed to create subdomains for non top-level domains

subdomainRules.description: Subdomain rules allow domain owners to define rules for subdomains

domain.$comment: In order to register a domain you need to create a preorder in an earlier block. The preorder step is needed to prevent man-in-the-middle attacks. The create deletes the preorder. A new domain's identity record must be its owner (rule recordsIdentityIsOwner, judged until the domain is first transferred or sold). Domain documents are immutable: modification and deletion are refused, transfer and purchase are allowed

saltedDomainHash.description: Double sha-256 of the concatenation of a 32 byte random salt, the normalized label, '.' and the parent domain name

preorder.$comment: Preorder documents are immutable. The domain create that reveals a preorder deletes it
